method: Primary visual inspection plus independent comparison against the two actually inspected source images; text-only initial/refined trials reviewed separately.
distribution: Source pixels remain private. Two attached-reference outputs and the initial text-only output remain local-only. The refined text-only illustration is distributed as a new README sample; promotional overview graphics are separate generated layouts, not pixel-identical evidence.
execution_boundary: Four initial/profile-refinement female calls returned images. One additional attached-reference daylight body/hand-interaction call was input-blocked without an image. These observations do not replay the v1.9 blocked inputs unchanged, isolate moderation causes, prove identity independence, or establish a stable success rate.

cases.visual_review: Attached reference retained platinum bangs, direct gaze, softly parted lips, fingertip-near-cheek action, ivory headwear and layered fabrics, rose background and soft portrait lighting.
limitations: Head tilt and shoulder asymmetry weakened toward a more frontal portrait.
Palm covers more cheek area than the source; exact hand shape differs.
